findings.mechanism: Cache entries are never evicted, so memory grows linearly with distinct queries
findings.remediation: Add a size limit or eviction policy (e.g., LRU) to the cache and purge old entries

findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern – a separate DB query for each matching document
findings.remediation: Fetch the body together with id and title in a single query (e.g., JOIN) or batch the by_id calls

prediction.condition: one cold search over 40 matching documents

findings.mechanism: Key‑stretching hash does ~60 000 SHA‑256 rounds per request, consuming CPU and saturating the single worker
findings.remediation: Reduce _ROUNDS or move verification to a background task / cache verified tokens
findings.arithmetic: ≈60 000 hashes × ~0.01 ms ≈ 600 ms of CPU per request
